The strongest targeted improvement is to restore the prior exposure balance: reduce `relative_nearness` from `0.32` to `0.30` and restore `path_intrusion` from `0.13` to `0.15`. This exact weighting previously achieved `0.9301`, while also improving false-clear from `0.0471` to `0.0377`, so the gain does not trade away the hard safety diagnostic. It also improved Spearman, pairwise accuracy, parent-floor Spearman, and negative-control gap. The cost was a modest false-block increase from `0.0865` to `0.0955`.
